name_input: KSG AUTOMATION PRIVATE LIMITED; KSG AUTOMATION PVT. LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey page for KSG AUTOMATION PRIVATE LIMITED (https://importkey.com/countries/india/ksg-automation-private-limited) reports 'Total Shipments 444 Records detected', 'Trading Partners 9', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-26', but every visible row is inbound to India, e.g. '2026-02-26 | E-GLOBALEDGE HONG KONG CHINA LIMITED | KSG AUTOMATION PRIVATE LIMITED | 3592 JD DATA CARTRIDGE ... | HONG KONG, JAPAN | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 85232980 | BOL 7765346'. No outbound shipment row with India as origin was seen. The only outward-looking line is an aggregated counterparty block: '10 | PRINTEK SUPPLIES LLC | KSG AUTOMATION PRIVATE LIMITED, BRIGHTEX SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED, DUBAI, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES' — a multi-company aggregate with no date, HS code or B/L number, so it cannot be counted as an export record. Source counter vs rows seen: page claims 444 shipments; 5 individual shipment rows visible (all imports), 0 export rows.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report domestic sales split was found in the sources reachable in this session. ImportKey shows only customs (import) activity; no domestic supply record was observed.
note: Role: trader/importer of IT consumables (LTO data cartridges, screen protectors) — declared HS 852351/854231 does not match the observed customs HS 85232980 (data cartridges) and 39269099 (screen protectors); per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, the code should be corrected to the factual one. Shipment evidence is import-side only: 444 records claimed, 5 rows actually seen, all inbound to Delhi Air Cargo / Patparganj ICD from Hong Kong, China, Japan, USA. No dated export bill of lading with India as origin was found, so export_status = none_found (not 'declared only' — the company does not even claim exports in the sources read). Domestic supply evidence: not found, status unknown rather than none_found because GST/GeM/CPPP sources were not reachable (Volza and Eximpedia returned HTTP 403, DuckDuckGo search backend was down). Revenue and export volume: null — not public in the sources read, not estimated. No CIN/PAN verified.
